decision.reason: [ev-4fdefdd841ec] clearly says the operator no longer puts the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label on pods and external listener Services, and tells users to use `strimzi.io/pod-name` instead. So "removed" is the right change type. The proposed subject is still wrong. A label on resources the operator manages is not a key in a configuration file or ConfigMap, and component "strimzi-kafka-operator" is just the product's own repository name, which the rules forbid. None of the allowed families fits a label on managed resources (protocol-behavior means wire behaviour), so I can't write a correct subject without forcing it into the wrong family. That gap in the family list needs a decision from a person or a taxonomy update.
